description: a tall soul reaper in a deep black hood, the face hidden behind a pale silver metal mask with dark eye slits, black leather and dark steel armour with thin gold trim and pale bone-coloured spiked pauldrons, a dark belt, a long tattered black cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, black boots with pale knee guards, no ghostly flames, no scythes and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and the mask pointing right, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the hood to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
